diagnostic_findings.evidence: 83 of 88 selected filings reached classifier-ready SUCCESS; 94.318% exceeds the frozen 90% technical floor.
diagnostic_findings.inference: The terminal sparsity is not explained by the repaired Playwright transport or aggregate PDF materialization failure.

diagnostic_findings.evidence: Selected results include keyword hits unrelated to direct AI commercialization, including names/titles containing 智/算/力 in cash-management, liquidation and 财务决算 contexts.
diagnostic_findings.inference: The CNINFO full-text searchkey candidate layer has materially lower semantic precision than the frozen AI-Core classifier.

diagnostic_findings.evidence: Frozen triage skips only two narrowly defined 业绩说明会 administrative title patterns; otherwise it routes filings to materialization.
diagnostic_findings.inference: Low positive yield cannot reasonably be attributed to broad pre-classifier triage exclusion under the frozen implementation.

diagnostic_findings.evidence: Selection is deterministic SHA256 order, maximum six per window, at most one filing per security. At least one observed window (2023Q2_J12) had 20 development-universe rows but only six selected.
diagnostic_findings.inference: The frozen cap creates a demonstrable source-stage censoring mechanism in dense windows. Existing evidence does not establish that censored rows would have been positive.

diagnostic_findings.evidence: The frozen design samples seven anchor windows per quarter, each anchor through anchor+6 calendar days, for 56 windows across 2023-2024; sparse-result window expansion is explicitly forbidden.
diagnostic_findings.inference: The experiment is a sampled source-coverage design rather than exhaustive historical announcement coverage. Whether denser coverage yields enough additional positives remains untested.

diagnostic_findings.evidence: ELIGIBLE_AI_CORE requires issuer subject, a direct AI-role token and a commercial-operation token in the same sentence; third-party context, internal adoption and R&D/future-only evidence do not qualify.
diagnostic_findings.inference: Many apparently AI-related filings can correctly remain NOT_ESTABLISHED or excluded; this is frozen semantic discipline, not a post-result defect.

diagnostic_findings.evidence: Six of eight positives are SSE:600186; all eight positives occur in 2024.
diagnostic_findings.inference: The information-floor failure is structural in both cross-sectional diversity and observed historical density, not merely a one-event threshold miss.

problem_elimination_pass.delete: Do not repeat the same 56-window run; it has a valid terminal result.
problem_elimination_pass.avoid: Do not rescue the frozen experiment by weakening gates, relabeling, manual document insertion or outcome-guided source changes.
problem_elimination_pass.absorb: Reuse the existing frozen collector, temporal provenance logic and classifier as invariants in any later source-coverage experiment where applicable.
problem_elimination_pass.substitute: If further source development is approved, test source coverage as a new preregistered experiment rather than modifying the failed frozen contract.
problem_elimination_pass.precompute_reuse: Reuse the 88 selected rows, 83 classifier-ready decisions, window receipts and hashes as immutable diagnostic evidence.
problem_elimination_pass.optimize: Only after a new contract is frozen may implementation optimize retrieval efficiency without changing preregistered research semantics.

next_experiment_hypotheses_not_yet_autho: Denser or exhaustive time coverage may increase recall without changing the AI-Core positive definition.
A preregistered discovery design that reduces CNINFO keyword-collision noise may improve candidate precision without changing positive labels.
A preregistered selection design may test whether the six-per-window cap materially suppresses valid positives in dense windows.
epistemic_limits: This diagnosis does not claim that any proposed source expansion would satisfy the frozen 20/12/12/6/20% information floor.
